title: How to Book Site Visits from Online Enquiries: The 7-Minute Rule

faqs.question: What is the speed rule for booking real estate site visits?
faqs.answer: The speed rule says that contacting a buyer within a few minutes of their online enquiry works better than waiting, because their interest in your property is still fresh.

faqs.question: What is the benchmark site visit conversion rate in India?
faqs.answer: Average digital real estate campaigns achieve a 3% to 5% site visit rate from raw leads. High-performing funnels using instant WhatsApp automation and fast qualification achieve 12% to 18% site visit completion.

faqs.question: Why do prospective buyers agree to a site visit and then not show up?
faqs.answer: No-shows happen because the prospect lacked conviction, received no reminder sequence, or was overwhelmed by spam calls from other brokers.

faqs.question: Should builders offer free cab pickups for site visits?
faqs.answer: Yes. In competitive micro-markets like Noida Expressway or Greater Noida West, offering an Uber/Ola voucher or complimentary cab service increases physical attendance on high-ticket luxury projects (₹1.5Cr+) by over 30%.

faqs.question: How should sales executives ask for the site visit appointment?
faqs.answer: Never ask open-ended questions like 'When can you visit?'. Which works better for your family?'

faqs.question: What role does WhatsApp play in confirming site visits?
faqs.answer: WhatsApp serves as the verification anchor: send a live Google Map pin, project entry gate directions, the relationship manager's direct contact card, and a digital visitor pass.

faqs.question: How many times should a sales rep follow up before dropping a lead?
faqs.answer: Sales reps should execute a minimum of 6 structured follow-ups across 14 days (calls, WhatsApp video teasers, and SMS reminders) before reassigning a cold lead to the automated nurture database.

faqs.question: Can virtual 3D tours replace physical site visits?
faqs.answer: Virtual 3D tours are excellent micro-qualification tools that filter out casual browsers, but they do not replace physical site visits where families evaluate construction quality, neighborhood vibes, and sample flat finishes.
